MSG Holiday Festival Champions |bowl= NCAA Tournament |bowl_result=Round of 64 }} {{2010–11 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2010–11 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team''' represented [[St. John's University (New York)|St. John's University]] during the [[2010–11 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The [[team]] was coached by [[Steve Lavin]] in his first year at the school. Saint John's home games were played at [[Carnesecca Arena]] and [[Madison Square Garden]] and the team was a member of the [[Big East Conference (1979–2013)|Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 21–12, 12–6 in Big East play and lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2011 Big East men's basketball tournament]] to [[2010–11 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]]. They received an at-large bid in the [[2011 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2010–11 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]].{{Cite journal |last=Schwabbauer |first=M. L. |date=December 1975 |title=Use of the latent image technique to develop and evaluate problem-solving skills |url=https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2010 |journal=The American Journal of Medical Technology |volume=41 |issue=12 |pages=457–462 |issn=0002-9335 |pmid=2010}} ==Off season== On March 30, 2010, [[Steve Lavin|Lavin]] was announced as the head coach of [[St. John's University (New York)|St. John's]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/news/story?id=5041205|title=St. John's hires former UCLA hoops coach Lavin|date=March 30, 2010|website=ESPN.com}} Lavin replaced [[Norm Roberts]], who was fired after six seasons as the Red Storm head coach.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/news/story?id=5008933|title=St. John's fires coach Roberts after sixth season|date=March 19, 2010|website=ESPN.com}} Lavin named his mentor [[Gene Keady]] to the position of Special Assistant. ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" ! The Red Storm (17–9, 9–5 Big East) had won game over ranked teams, with wins over Duke, Notre Dame, Connecticut, Georgetown, and Pittsburgh,{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/news/story?id=6144478|title=Duke No. 1 in coaches' poll; St. John's returns|date=February 21, 2011|website=ESPN.com}} all of which were in the top-15.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/blog/collegebasketballnation/post/_/id/23638/st-johns-spreading-news-with-win-against-pitt|title=St. John's spreading news with upset of Pitt|date=February 19, 2011|website=ESPN.com}} The Red Storm were looking for their first [[NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Championship|NCAA tournament]] berth since 2002.[https://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5gTp9nu4mHg6JHU8NAntGFHkcP5IQ?docId=a998608820a648f58d73a98a73ec8344]{{dead link|date=June 2024|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}} After defeating then #4 Pittsburgh on February 19, all 63 participating brackets in The Bracket Project placed the Red Storm within the NCAA Tournament.{{Cite web |url=http://bracketproject.50webs.com/matrix.htm |title = The Bracket Project's Bracket Matrix - 2011 |access-date=2011-02-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110222045848/http://bracketproject.50webs.com/matrix.htm |archive-date=2011-02-22 |url-status=dead }} The Red Storm also achieved their first Top 25 ranking in over a decade. The last time the Red Storm had previously been ranked was on November 28, 2000.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/blog/new-york/colleges/post/_/id/1698/rapid-reaction-st-johns-60-pitt-59|title=Rapid Reaction: St. John's 60, Pitt 59|date=February 19, 2011|website=ESPN.com}} On February 21, the Red Storm were ranked #23 in the AP Poll and #25 in the ESPN/USA Today Coaches Poll.{{cite news| url=https://www.usatoday.com/sports/college/mensbasketball/usatpoll.htm | work=USA Today | title=Most Popular E-mail Newsletter | date=April 3, 2012}} They reached as high as #15 in both the AP Poll and the ESPN/USA Today Coaches Poll on February 28 following their road win against Villanova.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/rankings/_/week/17/year/2011/seasontype/2|title=2010-11 Men's College Basketball Rankings for Week 17|website=ESPN}} ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header|year=2010|team=St. John's Red Storm|teamcolors=y|high_school=y}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Dwayne|last=Polee II|num=0|pos=F|ft=6|in=7|lbs=193|class=FR|rs=|home=[[Los Angeles, California|Los Angeles, CA]]|high_school=[[Westchester High School (Los Angeles)|Westchester H.S.]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=D.
